```{r}
# Packages
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(nlme)
library(nlraa)
library(car)
library(performance)
theme_set(theme_classic())
active_wd <- function(x, verbose = FALSE) {
    mkdir <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
    mkdir <- sub("[^/]*$", "", mkdir)
    mkdir <- paste0(mkdir, x)
    setwd(mkdir)
    if (verbose == TRUE) {
        return(getwd())
    }
}
active_wd("data")
```

# Experiment 1 and 2
```{r}
# Data
exp1_2 <- read.csv("combined_exp1_2.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
exp1_2$repetition <- as.factor(exp1_2$repetition)
exp1_2$Participant <- factor(exp1_2$Participant, labels = "p")
```

```{r}
# Experiment 1 model
exp1 <- exp1_2[exp1_2$type == "Homogenous", ]
exp1 <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp1)
exp1_model <- gls(y ~ x, data = exp1, weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.)))
summary(exp1_model)
# Features of the model:
# Fixed effects only (no random effects)
# Heteroscedastic (variance of residuals can change with fitted values)
# The homoscedastic model was far from normally distributed, even heteroscedastic has some outliers.
# No grouping variables

# Add pearson residuals to dataset
exp1$residuals <- residuals(exp1_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp1$residuals)
qqline(exp1$residuals)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
exp1_boot <- boot_gls(exp1_model, cores = 7)
# confint(exp1_boot)
# hist(exp1_boot)
```

```{r}
# Experiment 2 model
exp2 <- exp1_2[exp1_2$type == "Heterogenous", ]
exp2 <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp2)
exp2_model <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x,
    random = ~ 1 + x | Participant,
    data = exp2,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)
summary(exp2_model)
anova(exp2_model)
VarCorr(exp2_model) # Variance of random effects
coef(summary(exp2_model)) # values of fixed effects
coef(exp2_model) # coefficient values (fixed + random) for individual subjects
ranef((exp2_model)) # random effects for each subject
# Features of the model:
# Fixed and random effects
# Model with only fixed effect significantly worse - suggests that variance across participants is meaningful.
# Includes both intercepts and slopes
# Heteroscedastic (variance of residuals can change with fitted values)
# Only small number of outliers
# No grouping variables

# Add pearson residuals to dataset
exp2$residuals <- residuals(exp2_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp2$residuals)
qqline(exp2$residuals)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
exp2_boot <- boot_lme(exp2_model, cores = 7)
# confint(exp2_boot)
# hist(exp2_boot)
```

# Experiment 3

```{r}
# Data
exp3 <- read.csv("combined_exp3.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
exp3$repetition <- as.factor(exp3$repetition)
exp3$Participant <- factor(exp3$Participant, labels = "p")
```

```{r}
# Homogenous
exp3_hom <- exp3[exp3$type == "Homogenous", ]
exp3_hom <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp3_hom)
exp3_hom_model <- gls(
    y ~ x,
    data = exp3_hom,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.))
)
summary(exp3_hom_model)
anova(exp3_hom_model)
# Features of the model:
# Fixed effects only (no random effects)
# Heteroscedastic (variance of residuals can change with fitted values)
# Includes all terms based on envelope and repetition
# Effect of standard:envelope_1:repetition is significant according to ANOVA

# Add pearson residuals to dataset
exp3_hom$residuals <- residuals(exp3_hom_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp3_hom$residuals)
qqline(exp3_hom$residuals)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
exp3_hom_boot <- boot_gls(exp3_hom_model, cores = 7)
# confint(exp3_hom_boot)
# hist(exp3_hom_boot)
```

```{r}
# Heterogenous
exp3_het <- exp3[exp3$type == "Heterogenous", ]
exp3_het <- groupedData(formula = y ~ x | Participant, data = exp3_het)
exp3_het_model <- lme(
    fixed = y ~ x + repetition,
    random = ~ 1 + x | Participant,
    data = exp3_het,
    weights = varPower(form = ~ fitted(.) | Participant)
)
summary(exp3_het_model)
anova(exp3_het_model)
VarCorr(exp3_het_model) # Variance of random effects
coef(summary(exp3_het_model)) # values of fixed effects
coef(exp3_het_model) # coefficient values (fixed + random) for individual subjects
ranef((exp3_het_model)) # random effects for each subject
# Features of the model:
# Fixed and random effect
# Model with only fixed effect significantly worse - suggests that variance across participants is meaningful.
# Includes both intercepts and slopes
# Heteroscedastic (variance of residuals can change with fitted values)
# Includes repetition (significant according to ANOVA)

# Add pearson residuals to dataset
exp3_het$residuals <- residuals(exp3_het_model, type = "p")
qqnorm(exp3_het$residuals)
qqline(exp3_het$residuals)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
exp3_het_boot <- boot_lme(exp3_het_model, cores = 7)
# confint(exp3_het_boot)
# hist(exp3_het_boot)
```

```{r}
boots <- data.frame(
    id = rep(1:4, each = 999),
    intercept = c(
        exp1_boot$t[, 1],
        exp2_boot$t[, 1],
        exp3_hom_boot$t[, 1],
        exp3_het_boot$t[, 1]
    ),
    slope = c(
        exp1_boot$t[, 2],
        exp2_boot$t[, 2],
        exp3_hom_boot$t[, 2],
        exp3_het_boot$t[, 2]
    )
)
bootsorg <- data.frame(
    id = 1:4,
    intercept = c(
        exp1_boot$t0[1],
        exp2_boot$t0[1],
        exp3_hom_boot$t0[1],
        exp3_het_boot$t0[1]
    ),
    slope = c(
        exp1_boot$t0[2],
        exp2_boot$t0[2],
        exp3_hom_boot$t0[2],
        exp3_het_boot$t0[2]
    )
)

bootsconf <- data.frame(
    id = rep(1:4, each = 2),
    intercept = c(
        confint(exp1_boot)[1, ],
        confint(exp2_boot)[1, ],
        confint(exp3_hom_boot)[1, ],
        confint(exp3_het_boot)[1, ]
    ),
    slope = c(
        confint(exp1_boot)[2, ],
        confint(exp2_boot)[2, ],
        confint(exp3_hom_boot)[2, ],
        confint(exp3_het_boot)[2, ]
    )
)

boots |>
    ggplot(aes(intercept)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue") +
    geom_vline(data = bootsorg, aes(xintercept = intercept), linetype = 2, color = "red") +
    geom_vline(data = bootsconf, aes(xintercept = intercept), linetype = 2, color = "orange") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~id)


boots |>
    ggplot(aes(slope)) +
    geom_histogram(color = "black", fill = "cornflowerblue") +
    geom_vline(data = bootsorg, aes(xintercept = slope), linetype = 2, color = "red") +
    geom_vline(data = bootsconf, aes(xintercept = slope), linetype = 2, color = "orange") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    facet_wrap(~id)
```

anova(quick2)
